cases.summary: User selects SIM Swap from Customer Services
cases.preconditions: Logged in on staging with EnvConfig inventory agent (PDV) after PIN validation
cases.input: 1. Open Customer Services. 2. Select SIM Swap.
cases.expected: SIM Swap flow starts. Allowed profiles in the ticket: POA, Dealer Shop, Team Leader, Staff. PDV may not be authorised; record if the action is hidden.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-001; Step 1: Select SIM Swap

cases.summary: MFS balance below 2,000 FCFA allows SIM Swap
cases.preconditions: On Customer Services with an eligible customer MSISDN; customer MFS balance 1,999 FCFA
cases.expected: SIM Swap is allowed. Maximum allowed balance is 1,999 FCFA.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-002; MFS Balance < 2,000 FCFA

cases.summary: MFS balance 2,000 FCFA or more blocks with the quoted message
cases.preconditions: On Customer Services with an eligible customer MSISDN; customer MFS balance 2,000 FCFA
cases.expected: SIM Swap is blocked. Message: "Sim swap not authorised. Please redirect customer to the nearest store."
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-003; Balance ≥ 2,000 FCFA

cases.summary: Regular is the default SIM Swap type
cases.preconditions: Balance check passed
cases.expected: Options are Regular (Default) and Procuration.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-004; Step 3: Select SIM Swap Type

cases.summary: Procuration captures the procuration document
cases.preconditions: Procuration selected
cases.input: 1. Continue without the procuration document. 2. Upload it.
cases.expected: FE captures procuration document. IsProcuration=1 on the request (backend evidence).
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-005; Procuration Rules

cases.summary: Supported ID types are offered
cases.preconditions: On ID type selection
cases.expected: National ID Card, Foreign Passport, CEDEAO Card, Refugee Card are available.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-006; Step 4: Select ID Type

cases.summary: OCR extracts name, DOB, ID number; failure requires retake; OCR data not editable
cases.preconditions: ID scan step
cases.input: 1. Scan front and back where applicable. 2. Force an OCR failure. 3. Attempt to edit OCR fields.
cases.expected: OCR extracts First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, ID Number. On failure the user must retake. User cannot manually edit OCR data.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-007, REQ-008; Step 5: Scan Customer ID

cases.summary: Unsupported document is blocked
cases.preconditions: An unsupported document
cases.expected: Error is shown. Transaction is blocked. Exact message is not quoted.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-009; Unsupported Document

cases.summary: KYC First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, ID Number are all required
cases.preconditions: On KYC verification
cases.input: 1. Leave each mandatory field empty in turn.
cases.expected: All four fields required. Incomplete mandatory fields cannot continue.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-010, REQ-022; Step 6: Verify KYC Information

cases.summary: Successful identity comparison proceeds to SIM scan
cases.preconditions: OCR data matches customer record on First Name, Last Name, Date of Birth, National ID Number
cases.expected: Verification successful. Flow proceeds to SIM scan.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-011; Verification Successful

cases.summary: Failed verification shows the quoted message
cases.preconditions: OCR data does not match the customer record
cases.expected: Message: "Identification failed. We were unable to verify customer identity."
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-012; Verification Failed

cases.summary: Failed verification without re-identification rights shows Cancel and Try Again
cases.preconditions: Agent not authorised for Re-identification; verification failed
cases.expected: Buttons: Cancel, Try Again.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-013; User not authorised for Re-identification

cases.summary: Failed verification with re-identification rights offers Re-identify Customer
cases.preconditions: Agent authorised for Re-identification; verification failed
cases.expected: Buttons: Cancel, Try Again, Re-identify Customer. For Senegal, redirect to SIM Swap Uncertified Customer Flow.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-014; User authorised for Re-identification

cases.summary: Non-certified customer may need habit questionnaire and extra documents
cases.preconditions: Eligible non-certified customer
cases.expected: Identification may require Habit Questionnaire and Additional Documents. Service is allowed only if customer status is eligible.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-015; Non-Certified Customer Rules

cases.summary: Burnt SIM / unreadable ICCID shows the quoted error
cases.preconditions: On SIM scan; ICCID not readable
cases.input: 1. Scan or enter an unreadable ICCID.
cases.expected: Message: "Sim deactivated. Please scan another sim." Options: Try Again, Cancel.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-016; Burnt SIM / ICCID Not Readable

cases.summary: ICCID already activated shows the quoted error
cases.preconditions: Already activated ICCID
cases.expected: Message: "Sim already registered. Please scan another sim." Options: Try Again, Cancel.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-017; ICCID Already Activated

cases.summary: User can scan barcode or enter ICCID manually
cases.preconditions: On SIM scan
cases.input: 1. Scan barcode. 2. Enter ICCID manually on another attempt.
cases.expected: Both scan ICCID and enter ICCID manually are available. Supported scan method is Barcode.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-018; SIM Scan and ICCID Validation

cases.summary: PIN completes swap; receipt fields and actions
cases.preconditions: All prior steps successful
cases.input: 1. Enter PIN. 2. Observe receipt. 3. Download. 4. Share.
cases.expected: New SIM is activated and ICCID updated. Receipt: Certification Status = Certified, SIM Activation Status = Sim Activated, Customer Identity Verified, Transaction ID. Download Receipt and Share Receipt are available.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-019, REQ-020; SIM Swap Completion / Receipt

cases.summary: Regular vs Procuration attachments
cases.preconditions: One Regular and one Procuration swap
cases.expected: Regular: ID Front and ID Back if applicable. Procuration: ID documents plus procuration document.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-005, REQ-006; Attachment Requirements

cases.summary: Anti-fraud repeated ID rule has no expected result
cases.preconditions: Same ID used in 3 SIM swap attempts the same day on different MSISDNs with different identities
cases.expected: Cannot be expected-resulted. The Expected Result heading under Anti-Fraud Validation is empty.
cases.traceability: SAA-918; REQ-021; Anti-Fraud Validation
